title: Quo integrations 101: What connects, and what it does for you
summary: Quo integrations keep your CRM in sync automatically and connect your calls and texts to Claude, ChatGPT, or your own AI agent. Here's what each one unlocks.
body_markdown:
For many businesses, useful information gets shared on a call or in a text, then goes nowhere. It never reaches the CRM, the spreadsheet, or the Slack channel where your team needs it.


[Integrations](https://www.quo.com/integrations) move that information into the tools your team already uses, so you can put it to work.


Here’s what you need to know about Quo’s CRM and LLM integrations and what they help your team do.


##


**What are Quo integrations?**


Quo integrations connect your phone system to other tools in your tech stack. These integrations can push Quo data elsewhere to:


- Give your team the context they need in your CRM
- Trigger the next step in a workflow your team relies on
- Provide managers better oversight and surface insights that can help your team improve


##


**What this unlocks**


When information related to specific conversations gets lost in the wind, it can lead to asking for information again and other experiences that leave your contacts dissatisfied.


Native CRM integrations keep contact details and activity in sync passively, without anyone lifting a finger. Claude, ChatGPT, and MCP connectors go further: they turn a rep or manager’s calls and texts into something they can quickly review and act on.


### **Keeping your team in sync**


You can automatically keep your team in sync connecting any of these CRMs to Quo:


- HubSpot
- Salesforce
- Pipedrive
- Zoho CRM
- Attio
- Jobber
- JobTread
- House Call Pro
- Clio


Here’s what else is possible after integrating your CRM:


#### **1. Instant caller ID from your CRM**


When a matched number calls or texts, that contact’s CRM record automatically pops up in Quo, showing their name, company, title, and a link to the record. Nobody has to pause mid-call to figure out who’s calling.


#### **2. Call with one click**


With the Quo desktop app open, click any phone number inside your CRM, and Quo dials it for you. You don’t need to copy and paste the number, switch screens, or dial by hand.


#### **3. Skip the manual data entry**


Nobody has to remember to write down what happened on a call. Every call, recording, AI call summary, and text automatically attaches to the right contact in your CRM, without anyone touching a keyboard. You can easily see who said what, whether it involved a colleague or Sona, Quo’s AI voice agent.


#### **4. No more duplicate records**


Your CRM and Quo stay in sync, so nobody has to compare notes to figure out which version is right, or go back and fix two records that don’t match anymore.


*Looking for a CRM to start with or not sure which one to connect? Check out Quo’s*[supported integrations](https://www.quo.com/integrations) *.*


### **Save hundreds of hours**


CRM integrations work in the background, keeping records in sync without manual updates. Claude, ChatGPT, and MCP connectors let you automate other repetitive tasks. While the possibilities are endless, here are a few common ways growing teams are using these AI tools with Quo.


#### **Follow-up faster**


Using the Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok Bot connector, ask which contacts still need a follow-up, and let it draft the message. Review it, then send it from Quo. Here are a few follow-up prompts to get you started.


*“Pull my last 20 messages on \[my business phone number\] and flag any new leads who haven’t had a reply yet.”*


*“Pull the transcript from my last call with \[customer name\]. Draft a follow-up text that recaps what we discussed and confirms next steps.”*


*“Pull my calls and texts from the past week on \[my business phone number\]. Give me a summary: how many calls, how many texts, and which conversations still need a follow-up.”*


For more, see[23 Claude prompts to get more out of every conversation in Quo](https://www.quo.com/blog/claude-prompt-examples/) .


*Claude and ChatGPT only see what your Quo account can already see, and both ask for your approval before sending a text or creating a contact.*


#### **Identify what matters most**


Beyond one-off questions, you can set up reports that run on their own, flagging which conversations need attention or identifying patterns that may explain why the team is losing deals. That way, you spend your time growing the business instead of digging through old calls and texts.


Take Chase Gallagher, who runs CMG Landscaping, a design-build company outside Philadelphia, generating more than $2 million a year. He connected Quo to ChatGPT and checks in every week or two. Some of the questions he asks are:


*“How many follow-up phone calls did \[a rep\] make?”*


*“How many custom home builders or general contractors did we call this week?”*


*“Who answered the phones best this week?”*


Between this workflow and the rest of his setup, Chase’s team saves 60 hours a month and more than $70,000 a year.[Read the full story](https://www.quo.com/blog/landscaping-lead-management/) .


Prefer not to check in manually? Set up the same reports to run on a schedule instead, delivered to you automatically.


For a head start, Quo has ready-made[skill templates](https://www.quo.com/templates) , including call logs, daily reports, sales call coaching, and win-loss analysis, built for Claude and ChatGPT.


#### **Use Quo as a custom AI agent**


MCP, or Model Context Protocol, works like a universal adapter for AI tools. Instead of a custom connection for every app, Claude and ChatGPT[use MCP](https://support.quo.com/core-concepts/integrations/mcp) to plug securely into your other apps, including Quo. It’s what already runs the official Claude, ChatGPT, and Grok Bot connectors.


If you’re building your own AI agent or using a client other than Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok Bot, connect directly through the MCP server instead: add https://mcp.quo.com/mcp, and sign in with your Quo account. It’s more setup, but it gives your agent full control over the workflow: pulling messages and call transcripts, sending texts, and creating or updating contacts.


##


**Get started using Quo integrations**


How you turn on an integration depends on what you’re connecting:


- CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Attio, Zoho, Jobber):[Settings and Integrations in Quo](https://my.quo.com/settings/integrations)
- Claude or ChatGPT:[Claude’s connector directory](https://support.quo.com/core-concepts/integrations/mcp/claude#claude) or[ChatGPT’s app directory](https://support.quo.com/core-concepts/integrations/mcp/chatgpt#chatgpt)
- Custom or other AI agents: The[MCP server setup](https://support.quo.com/core-concepts/integrations/mcp/other-ai-agents)
